name: wildwood_scourge_sees_a_kicked_creature_enter_with_counters
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 5 H5-2). Wildwood Scourge: 'Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on Wildwood Scourge.' A kicked Gnarlid Colony enters with two +1/+1 counters. CR 122.6: counters an object is given as it enters are put on it, so the Scourge triggers, once for the one placement: 2 + 1 = 3 counters. Failed before the fix: the entering counters (EtBState, Executor._apply_etb_state) were added with no journal row, so no counter-placement event existed for the Scourge to see (2 counters).
